title: 106th Rescue Wing brings home fallen Airmen
description: Processions for Maj. Christopher T. Zanetis, a pilot, and Master Sgt. Christopher J. Raguso and Tech. Sgt. Dashan J. Briggs, special missions aviation specialists, assigned to the 106th Rescue Wing, exit F. S. Gabreski Air National Guard Base, Westhampton Beach, N.Y., March 27, 2018. The three Airmen were killed when the HH-60G Pavehawk helicopter they were flying in crashed near the city of Al-Qa’im, Iraq. (U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Julio A. Olivencia Jr.)
